## Rollback

Revert the PR. It adds one manifest, one report (plus its fixtures directory) and one `AGENTS.md` line. No runtime, GitOps, flag or publication state depends on them, and spikes are not part of the RoadmapPublication, so a revert has no downstream effect. If the owner rejects the spike without a verdict, set the manifest to `lifecycle: archived` instead of deleting it.
